content:
The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 was a **Total Solar Eclipse** on **August 11, 1999**.

This was a major event, and its path of totality was visible across densely populated areas, including the United Kingdom (Cornwall), France, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania, and Turkey, making it one of the most-watched eclipses in history.
